report.summary: No hard-constraint violations, rejected submissions, failure days, bed priority or fairness violations, or nurse gaps found on days 26-30. Beds followed census after the day-26 pool increase, and all L3 and L2 patients had beds on every day. L3 nursing was fully covered, and L2 shortages were the minimum whole-nurse result.
